records.question: In FY 2024-25, which CM Elevate Legacy schemes have disbursed less than half of the amount they sanctioned?
records.rewritten: Which CM Elevate Legacy schemes have disbursed less than half of the sanctioned amount in FY 2024-25?
records.sql: SELECT scheme_name, ROUND(SUM(sanctioned_amount) / 1e7, 2) AS sanctioned_cr, ROUND(SUM(total_disbursement) / 1e7, 2) AS total_disbursed_cr, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_disbursement) / NULLIF(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0), 1) AS disbursed_pct FROM curated.v_cm_elevate_disbursement WHERE financial_year_short = '2024-25' AND scheme_name IN (SELECT scheme_name FROM curated.dim_cm_elevate_disb_scheme WHERE NOT scheme_name IN ('Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme (spinning)', 'Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme(weaving)')) GROUP BY scheme_name HAVING SUM(total_disbursement) < 0.5 * SUM(sanctioned_amount) ORDER BY disbursed_pct ASC
records.answer:
This report details sanctioned amounts across all CM Elevate Legacy schemes in Meghalaya for FY 2024-25:
Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse Scheme is the largest with ₹30.75 crore; Meghalaya Goat Farming Scheme is the smallest with ₹0.48 crore.
- **Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse Scheme** — ₹30.75 crore; total disbursed ₹14.22 crore; disbursed 46.20%
- **Meghalaya Sports & Wellness Scheme** — ₹11.76
